observations: Photo 0 shows the control panel of a silver electronic keyboard.
The brand 'YAMAHA' is visible at the bottom center of the panel.
A small LCD screen is active, displaying a menu with '001 Live! Grand Piano' selected.
The screen shows 'MAIN 1' and 'PERFORMANCE REPOSITORY' at the bottom.
The panel has buttons for 'SONG', 'STYLE', 'VOICE', 'BANK', and 'MIDI MEMORY'.
The image contains a watermark 'SEUNSTICS ENTERPRISE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
The keyboard body is not fully visible; only the top control section is shown.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included. Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The keyboard may have dead keys or a faulty sustain pedal.
risks.proof: A video of a chromatic scale being played across all keys and a demonstration of the sustain pedal.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be dead or the power adapter may be faulty.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery compartment and a video showing the keyboard powered on without the AC adapter.

risks.risk: The LCD screen may have dead pixels or backlight failure.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the screen while the keyboard is powered on.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the keyboard playing a full chromatic scale to test all keys.
Photo of the LCD screen while the keyboard is powered on.
Photo of the battery compartment and the rear power adapter.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
